detect_shopify_secrets: use ShopifyDetector to scan codebases for Shopify access tokens and shared secrets
review_denylist_patterns: review the ShopifyDetector denylist regex patterns for shpat shpca shppa and shpss tokens
customize_secret_type: customize the ShopifyDetector secret_type property to rename detected secrets in reports
extend_denylist: extend the ShopifyDetector denylist with additional regex patterns for new Shopify token formats
integrate_detect_secrets: integrate ShopifyDetector as a plugin with detect-secrets to audit repositories for leaked Shopify credentials
